tools.name: ask_site
tools.description: Search the site's published help, solutions, and use-case content for a visitor's question. Use when a visitor wants to understand Cold Leads; returns matching excerpts and source URLs, or an explicit no-match result.

query.description: The visitor's question about Cold Leads.

tools.name: browse_plans
tools.description: Read the published plan features, limits, and monthly prices in supported currencies. Use when a visitor asks which plan fits or what it costs; returns current plan details from the site's plan data.

tools.name: start_signup
tools.description: Open Cold Leads' existing sign-in and sign-up page. Use when an unsigned visitor asks to create an account; returns a navigation confirmation and does not enter credentials or create an account.
